About this item

  • Keep Your Hands Safe: Our poo bags are 100% leak-proof and extra thick, never worry about your hands when you pick the poo up.
  • Super Value Pack: 36 rolls and 15 bags per roll, total 540 bags can supply up to 9 months(2 bags per day).
  • About Measures: Bag's size 33x23 cm, fits all size of dogs and each roll fits standard-size leash dispensers.
  • Main Material: Unlike other poo bags, ours are made with corn starch blend which more friendly to environment.
  • Earth Friendly: We use recycled materials in our packaging and roll cores because details matter.

How customer reviews and ratings work

Customer Reviews, including Product Star Ratings, help customers to learn more about the product and decide whether it is the right product for them.

To calculate the overall star rating and percentage breakdown by star, we don’t use a simple average. Instead, our system considers things like how recent a review is and if the reviewer bought the item on Amazon. It also analyses reviews to verify trustworthiness.

    5 out of 5 stars
    The ultimate line of defense against big dog walk hazards
    Reviewed in the United Kingdom on 4 August 2026
    Colour Name: BrownSize Name: 1 count (Pack of 540)
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    Let’s be honest: when you own a 4-year-old Black Labrador named Dexter, dog walks aren't just a casual stroll they are a high-volume operation. I have purchased this 540-bag pack three times now, which should tell you everything you need to know about both the quality of the bags and the sheer daily output I am dealing with. When you're out on a long walk, the absolute last thing you want is a paper-thin bag that leaves you playing a high-stakes game of "will my finger poke through?"

    Thankfully, these Greener Walker bags are absolute champions. They are extra thick and genuinely 100% leakproof, creating a very welcome barrier between your hand and whatever massive surprise your dog has left on the pavement. Despite being thick and durable, they tear off the roll cleanly without ripping down the middle. Best of all, they aren't impossible to separate at the top you don't need to stand on a windy pavement frantically trying to open the bag while your dog tries to chase a squirrel.

    The fact that they are made from a bio-cornstarch blend makes picking up after your dog feel just a little more eco-conscious. With 540 bags in the box (split into neat little rolls that fit standard leash dispensers), one purchase lasts for months, even with a dog who thinks two poops per walk is rookie numbers.

    If you want strong, reliable bags that protect your hands, open without a fight, and keep the planet happy, these are worth every penny. Easily a five-star rating and given Dexter’s appetite, I’ll undoubtedly be buying box number four soon!

    reißfest und robust bei gutem Umweltgedanken
    Reviewed in Germany on 16 April 2023
    Vine Customer Review of Free Product
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

    Das Produkt kam gut verpackt und schnell hier an.

    Diese Kotbeutel für den Hund sind angenehm zu halten und nicht plastisch, wie herkommliche Kotbeutel aus dem Supermarkt.

    Reißfest und robust mit guten Fassungsvermöge ohne in Gefahr zu kommen, versehentlich den Kot zu berühren. Jede Rolle der 25 Stück pro Verpackung hat 15 einzelne Beutel, was insgsamt für ca 6 Monate laut Hersteller halten sollte.

    Die Beutel passen in den üblichen Leinenspender und lassen sich einfach und schnell herausrollen. An der Reißnaht sind sie gut von der nächsten Rolle abzutrennen.

    Ein Vorteil bei den Beuteln ist vorallem der Umweltgedanke, da hier keinerlei Plastik verarbeitet wurde und die Beutel dadurch auch biologisch abbaubar sind.

    Das spielt sich auch im Preis wieder. Wer bereit ist etwas mehr füt Kotbeutel auszugeben und der Umwelt einen kleinen Teil gutes tun möchte, ist hier gut beraten.

  • Amazon Customer
    5 out of 5 stars
    Strong bags that never tear - and compostable
    Reviewed in Canada on 22 December 2023
    Colour Name: GreenSize Name: 1 count (Pack of 1080)
    Verified Purchase
    Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
    Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

    These dog waste bags are excellent. Unlike most bags I have used, these don’t tear and are very strong. I like that these bags are fully biodegradable, made from cornstarch, and are plastic-free.

    The bags are lightweight, so it is easy to carry a large quantity for walking and hiking. The bags are large and of sufficient size to easily pick up after my big dogs.

    The only time one of these bags has ripped was when I dropped a full bag that was tied shut and accidentally stepped on it. The bag exploded from the impact, as any bag would. I have experienced no holes or tears when opening the bags or when using them among thorns and branches. I have not had to worry about bags breaking, and can even pack full bags in a hiking pack to carry out waste with no leaks.

    The only thing I would change about these bags is that they have a cardboard cylinder in the middle of each roll, and for me, they would work fine to dispense from my walking bag without it.

    These are the best poo bags I have used, and I highly recommend them.

About this Item

  • Keep Your Hands Safe: Our poo bags are 100% leak-proof and extra thick, never worry about your hands when you pick the poo up.
  • Super Value Pack: 36 rolls and 15 bags per roll, total 540 bags can supply up to 9 months(2 bags per day).
  • About Measures: Bag's size 33x23 cm, fits all size of dogs and each roll fits standard-size leash dispensers.
  • Main Material: Unlike other poo bags, ours are made with corn starch blend which more friendly to environment.
  • Earth Friendly: We use recycled materials in our packaging and roll cores because details matter.

Product description

About Greener Walker

We are Greener Walker,we tried a variety of ways to protect the environment and finally we find it,the compostable and biodegradable bags.But this way is very very very slow and we just like a walker,but the pollution is a runner.So We need more walkers,we need you!

Love Pets Love Earth

For everyone who loves pets,pets are their family.Therefore,for pets and others,we should minimize the impact on the environment and others when we walking the dog.

Box Contains:

  • 15 Bags/roll and 36 Rolls,totally 540 Bags
  • Bag's Size:23cm x 33cm(9in x 13in)

NOTICE:

Please store these bags in a cool,dark,dry place and keep them out of sunlight and away from sources of heat or steam.Use all bags within 18 months of purchase,otherwise they will start to degrade over time.
